messages:
Anna: Quick snapshot — GreenCrest private rollout scheduled for TOMORROW EOD. Need clear ownership for: networking cutover, egress fallback, airgap media validation, and final smoke canary. Please call dibs or escalate.
Sam: I can own the networking cutover (firewall + VPC peering). Will validate with infra team today. ETA for rule push? :calendar:
Anna: Thanks. Can you also confirm the list of IPs/ports we'll open? Priya mentioned a last-minute proxy requirement.
Sam: Working on the list now. Current minimal egress: 13.224.0.0/14:443, 52.94.0.0/15:443, and our internal NTP + KMS endpoints. Will paste config in a sec.
Jin: I can take egress fallback and canary choreography. Plan: smoke canary in staging -> limited production with debug logs -> full traffic. Need the canary window (30m?) and a rollback playbook.
Anna: 30m sounds good. Jin, add rollback steps to ENG-3912 and link the runbook.
Priya: Quick note on airgap media — customer requires signed images and checksum verification. Marco, you flagged a signing gap last week, can you confirm images are signed and distro manifest is baked?
Marco: Confirmed images signed. Two small caveats: (1) the airgap installer expects the tarball at /opt/airgap/images/gc.tar, (2) checksum file name changed to sha256sum.txt in the packaging step. I updated the customer artifact in S3 (private bucket). I will post the exact commands.
Marco: ```
# download on customer host
curl -O https://s3.redwood-prod/private/gc.tar
curl -O https://s3.redwood-prod/private/sha256sum.txt
sha256sum -c sha256sum.txt
sudo ./install.sh --airgap --images gc.tar
```
Anna: Great. Priya, can your SE confirm the customer has the S3 proxy open? If not, we need an offline carrier USB plan.
Priya: SE confirmed proxy is blocked. Customer ops asked for a USB image. OpsBot: Created ticket ARTIFACT-224 for physical delivery. ETA 1 business day. :truck:
Anna: That changes timeline. If USB is needed, we can't do TOMORROW EOD. Can we still do a network-only dry-run tomorrow (no install) to validate peering and firewalls?
Sam: Yes, we can do network-only dry-run at 09:30 PT. I'll coordinate with customer netops. Send invite?
Anna: Sending invite. Jin, please prepare the canary manifest to use in the dry-run (no image install) so we can exercise routing + auth flows.
Jin: Will produce a manifest that hits auth + metrics endpoints only. Pushing to ENG-3912 now.
Marco: One more flag — the customer's HSM requires client cert CN to be set to the hostname. Make sure certgen step includes --cn <hostname>. I added example in the runbook.
Anna: Noted. Security review done? We had one pending comment about key rotation timing.
Priya: Security asked to rotate keys post-install (T+1h). We'll run an automated rotate job after canary success.
Anna: Ok folks — summarize ownership:
- Networking cutover: Sam
- Egress fallback & canary choreography: Jin
- Airgap media signing + packaging: Marco
- Customer coordination & SE: Priya
- Rollback/playbook and ticket tracking: Anna
If any objections, speak up now. Otherwise we'll proceed with network-only dry-run tomorrow 09:30 PT and reconvene 12:00 PT to decide install timing.
Sam: All good from networking side. :thumbsup:
Marco: Packaging ready, shipping hook in ARTIFACT-224. USB path if needed.
Jin: Canary manifest up. Will monitor logs and alert on error rate >1%.
Priya: SE will standby for USB handoff and will run preflight checklist once image is on customer host.
Anna: Perfect — assigning owners in ENG-3912 and adding timeline. Reassign me if anything blocks. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
OpsBot: Reminder: runbook link updated: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/GreenCrest-PRIVATE-ROLL. Next scheduled reminder in 6h.
Anna: Last call: any outstanding CRs blocking the installer? (code review pings)
Sam: There's one small CR for terraform rules (PR #4521). Tagging @jin for a quick review — it's safe to merge for the dry-run.
Jin: Reviewing now, should merge within 30m.
Anna: Thanks — I'll update ENG-3912 with final go/no-go at 11:45 PT. If USB still required, we'll postpone install to next business day.
